Barrett-Jackson Scottsdale Overview

Held each January at WestWorld of Scottsdale, Barrett-Jackson features:

  • Thousands of collector vehicles
  • Celebrity appearances
  • Live auctions with millions in sales
  • Automotive lifestyle exhibits
  • VIP experiences and hospitality

Logistics Challenges

WestWorld presents unique transportation challenges:

  • Parking: Limited, expensive, long walks
  • Crowds: 300,000+ attendees over 9 days
  • Traffic: North Scottsdale congestion peaks
  • Duration: Multi-hour auction sessions
